title: Gramma's Pretzels
description: Gramma’s no bake ranch and dill pretzels, tossed with seasoned canola oil and left to absorb it overnight.
ingredients: 2 bags Tom Sturgis mini pretzels (about 794 g total if using 397 g / 14 oz bags; check the package)
28 g Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix (1 packet, typically 1 oz)
2 g dried dill weed (2 teaspoons, approximate)
steps: Put the pretzels in a large bowl or container with enough room to turn them.
Mix the canola oil, ranch dressing mix, dill weed, and garlic powder until evenly combined.
Pour the seasoned oil over the pretzels and turn them thoroughly to coat.
Keep turning the pretzels occasionally and let them stand overnight so the seasoning and oil are absorbed.
notes: Transcribed from Gramma's handwritten recipe. The original calls for two bags of Tom Sturgis minis, without a bag weight, so 794 g is only an example for two 14 oz bags. Use the bag size you have. The handwritten method has no baking step.
